scientific_question: Without the five electronic flora/PlantNet source archives dominating source-matched reproductive versus vegetative trait K support, how many original within-family matched-species comparisons retain at least 20 species with native positive medians for both traits?
exclusion_rationale: These five pinned datasets describe electronic Floras or PlantNet and together contributed 49,746 of 65,043 source links for 279 same-DatasetID matched-organ species×pair cells. They are NOT assumed to be the only secondary/descriptive sources.

eligibility.original_numerical_species_rule: Exact source-native units, original species-rank and unambiguous genus eligibility, deduplicate all finite records by system/genus/binomial/dataset_id/observation_id/value; median >0, matching every one of 254 frozen system n_input_species.
eligibility.no_flora_numeric_species_rule: Within each ORIGINAL K-eligible species, recompute positive median from all original source records EXCEPT five frozen electronic flora datasets; do not add new species/taxa absent original graph.
eligibility.pair_same_species: For each of 760 fixed original K-blind family×trait pairs, count exact common binomials with the same unambiguous genus before and after five-flora removal. No pair is added based on observed K.
eligibility.no_flora_shared_dataset_rule: Within species passing no-flora median for both traits, require at least one same non-flora dataset_id with a finite positive observation for both traits. The same dataset_id DOES NOT prove identical source study or physical specimen.
eligibility.single_family_independence_unit: Plant family; do not interpret repeated trait pairs as independent evolutionary replicates.

descriptive_support_gates.if_insufficient: HOLD_NONFLORA_PRIMARY_MEASUREMENT_SCOPE_NOT_ESTABLISHED; report source-availability limitation, never a null biological result.

downstream_if_qualified.focus: Run within the same original source comparison, on no-flora-supported species and identical original native phylogenies for both organ traits: original ALL-source species medians versus floras-excluded medians. This is a new post-outcome robustness check, not independent trait validation.
downstream_if_qualified.important_estimand: Change in paired logK organ difference caused by five-flora source value substitution on identical species/tips/tree; do NOT compare full original-tip K to restricted-tip K as a pure source effect.

hard_nonclaims: All prospective-on-new-data replication gates for TRY v7 remain unchanged and unmet.

Five flora exclusion does not make remaining AusTraits values independent; many remaining source IDs may be monographs, Flora-derived compilation, curated taxonomic estimates or have primary record overlap.
Source-exclusion cohort was motivated after observing the K outcomes, organ hierarchy and source concentration; results are explicitly post-outcome sensitivity only.
A strong phylogenetic K value does not identify OU alpha, selection, absolute evolutionary rate or developmental constraint.
Do not reopen scientifically closed 201-system BIEN rho analysis or retune source OU from this post-outcome source exclusion.
